main_body: multi-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: blue-grey roof cap and tiled slope (rows 16-43)
evidence: Rows 16-43 show the top roof deck and pitched mansard slope with dormers, bordered by an orange cornice highlight (rows 44-45) and dark eave shadow (rows 46-47) above the recessed brick facade (rows 48-142).

style.evidence: Uses heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormers, chimney, and building edges rather than tinted material tones. Brick and roof surfaces have basic block shading but lack the granular per-tile and stone speckle texture of the Beodeul references.
